result.title: T-MUON: Tensorizing Muon via t-SVD for Large Language Model Pre-training
result.summary: Muon has recently emerged as a strong optimizer for large language model pretraining by exploiting matrix structure through polar orthogonalization. However, it processes each parameter matrix independently, whereas recent tensor-aware extensions of Muon jointly update groups of eligible matrix parameters through matrix unfoldings. In contrast, we propose T-MUON, a t-SVD-based generalization that groups structurally related Transformer gradients into third-order tensors and defines the corresponding Muon-style update directly through the $M$-transform. We show that the exact T-MUON update is a steepest-descent direction under the $\star_M$-spectral norm and establish a convergence guarantee. Across GPT-2-style and LLaMA-style models from 51M to 1.3B parameters trained on FineWeb and FineWeb-Edu, head-wise T-MUON with the identity transform consistently achieves lower validation perplexity than AdamW, Muon, and variants using DFT, DCT, or DST transforms. These gains persist in additional experiments with longer context lengths and larger token budgets, although the preferred tensorization mode varies across settings.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 T-MUON，用 t-SVD 与 M-变换将结构相关的 Transformer 梯度组织为三阶张量并定义 Muon 式更新，给出最速下降与收敛性分析，在 GPT-2/LLaMA 规模模型上验证困惑度收益。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于纯 LLM 预训练优化器与张量代数工作，关注参数更新而非推理期状态生成、视觉证据使用或推理监督，未提供与 LVR/VLM 推理相关的可核查线索。
